entry.title: Transport and venue
entry.content:
Transport

ERMC 2027 takes place in Katowice, Poland.
Katowice has an airport located outside the city with connections to destinations across the continent. Kraków Airport is around 2 hours away by train and 1 hour away by car and has even more connections. A train from Warsaw to Katowice takes 3–4 hours. The city is also directly connected by rail to several other countries, including Germany, the Czech Republic, Austria and Hungary.

Venue

ERMC 2027 takes place in the Katowice International Conference Centre, which is located in the city centre and forms part of a complex of buildings that includes the iconic Spodek landmark. A 400 m² ballroom will be our playing area with a separate room as the designated break area. We have already received a very good offer from the venue and have tentatively reserved the rooms for the championship. For a look at the venue, see the video from our previous tournament. You can also view the venue’s official presentation for much more in-depth information.
